list.title: Variables
list.subtitle: Shared variable sets. Link their environments to applications and stacks.
list.emptyBody: Group variables into sets with environments, share them with projects and link them to applications and stacks.
list.emptyBodyMember: No variable set is shared with your projects yet. Ask an instance owner or admin to create one.
list.usage: {apps, plural, =0 {No applications} one {# application} other {# applications}} · {stacks, plural, =0 {no stacks} one {# stack} other {# stacks}}

create.title: New variable set
create.description: A set holds variables per environment. Share it with projects, then link its environments to applications and stacks.
create.slugHint: Used by API token scopes and the CLI. Derived from the name when empty; it cannot be changed later.
create.slugInvalid: Lowercase letters, digits and -, not starting or ending with -, up to 64 characters.
create.defaultsNote: The set starts with development, staging and production (protected).

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.description: Projects whose applications and stacks may link this set.
sharing.noneSelected: Not shared with any project: only instance owners and admins see it.
sharing.keptNote: The selected projects stay on the list, so switching back keeps them.

details.title: Details
details.description: The slug is fixed: API token scopes and the CLI use it.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Irreversible actions for this variable set.
danger.deleteDescription: Every environment, its variables and its version history are deleted permanently. This cannot be undone. Unlink all applications and stacks first.
danger.confirmBody: All environments of this set and their variables and history are deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.

detail.aboutDescription: Managed by instance owners and admins.

accessNote.platform: You can manage this set and every environment.
accessNote.admin: You can reveal and edit unprotected environments. Protected ones are for instance owners and admins.
accessNote.developer: You can reveal and edit unprotected environments. Protected ones are for instance owners and admins.
accessNote.viewer: You can see variable names, not values.

editor.title: Environments
editor.description: One tab per environment. Values are masked until revealed; revealing is recorded in the audit log.
editor.variableCount: {count, plural, =0 {No variables} one {# variable} other {# variables}}
editor.empty: No variables in this environment yet.
editor.viewerNote: Viewers can see variable names only.
editor.protectedNote: Only instance owners and admins can reveal or edit the values of {name}.
editor.revealNote: Showing the values is recorded in the audit log.
editor.hidesIn: Shown values hide in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
editor.secretsStayMasked: Secret values stay masked; use their eye button to show one.
editor.revealThrottled: Too many reveals in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
editor.editorHint: Linked applications and stacks reference these as {ref}. Changes apply on their next deploy.
editor.unused: No application or stack you can see links {name}.
editor.linkedCount: {count, plural, one {Linked by # application or stack} other {Linked by # applications or stacks}}
editor.applyNote: Changes apply to applications and stacks on their next deploy, not to running containers.
editor.deleteItemDescription: The environment and all its variables are deleted permanently, together with its version history. This cannot be undone.
editor.addDescription: A new, empty set of variables, for example a preview or QA copy.
editor.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, up to 32 characters.
editor.protectedHint: Only instance owners and admins can reveal or edit its values.
editor.deleteDescription: The variables of this environment are deleted permanently.
editor.deleteInUse: Still linked by {apps}. Unlink it there first.

history.title: History of {name}
history.description: Every change to the variables of this environment. Values are shown only when you reveal a version.
history.empty: No changes recorded yet. The first change creates a version.

action.baseline: Content before the first recorded change

history.restoreBody: {name} gets the variables it had on {when}. This is saved as a new version, so nothing is lost and you can undo it from this history.
history.viewerNote: Viewers can read the history but not reveal or restore versions.
history.protectedNote: Only instance owners and admins can reveal or restore versions of {name}.

compare.title: Compare environments
compare.description: Compare two environments variable by variable. Only names are shown, never values.
compare.sameCount: {count, plural, =0 {No variable has the same value on both sides} one {# variable is the same on both sides} other {# variables are the same on both sides}}
compare.notComparable: Values are not compared because you cannot read both environments. Only names that exist on one side are shown, and nothing can be promoted.
compare.confirmBody: These variables are copied from {from} into {to}. A variable that already exists in {to} gets the new value; comments and order in {to} are kept, and new variables are added at the end. This is saved as a new version.
compare.promoted: {count, plural, one {# variable promoted} other {# variables promoted}} to {name}
compare.nothing: Nothing differs that could be promoted.

editor.notesHint: Notes are the # lines directly above a variable. They are visible without revealing values, so do not put secrets in them.

links.title: Variable sets
links.description: Environments of shared variable sets whose variables this receives. Changes apply on the next deploy.
links.emptyApp: No variable set linked. Only the application's own env is used.
links.emptyStack: No variable set linked. Only the stack's own env is used.
links.protectedNeedsAdmin: Linking or unlinking a protected environment needs the project admin role.
links.overriddenApp: The application's own env wins for: {keys}
links.overriddenStack: The stack's own env wins for: {keys}
links.noneShared: No variable set is shared with this project yet. See <link>Variables</link>.
links.orderApp: Merged top to bottom: a later link overrides an earlier one on the same key, and the application's own env always wins. Reference values as {ref}.
links.orderStack: Merged top to bottom: a later link overrides an earlier one on the same key, and the stack's own env always wins. Reference values as {ref}.
links.readOnly: Only developers and above can change the links.

picker.label: Variable set (optional)
picker.hint: More environments can be linked on the stack page later.

project.title: Variable sets
project.description: Sets shared with this project and where its applications and stacks use them.
project.empty: No variable set is shared with this project. See <link>Variables</link>.
